definition: A single football match played between a home team and an away team within one league and one season, with a final score expressed as home team goals and away team goals.
name: Match
scope: Match-level analysis of results, goals, draws and scheduling in the European football database.

definition: The competition season a match belongs to, labelled as a two-year span written 'YYYY/YYYY' (e.g. '2010/2011'). The label names the calendar year in which the season starts and the year in which it ends.
name: Season
scope: All season-scoped match analysis.

definition: A national football competition that a match belongs to, such as 'Belgium Jupiler League' or 'Poland Ekstraklasa'. Each league is associated with exactly one country.
name: League
scope: League-level rankings and filtering of matches.

definition: The country a league and its matches belong to, e.g. 'Poland', 'Belgium'. In this database each country corresponds to exactly one league.
name: Country
scope: Country-level filtering of matches.

aliases: highest build Up Play Speed teams
definition: A football club that plays matches, identified by a full display name (team_long_name, e.g. 'Ajax') and a short name (team_short_name, e.g. 'AJA').
name: Team
scope: Team identity, team tactical attributes and team-level ranking.

definition: Number of goals scored by the home team in a match. A non-negative integer per match.
name: Home Team Goal
scope: Match result and goal-scoring analysis.

definition: Number of goals scored by the away team in a match. A non-negative integer per match.
name: Away Team Goal
scope: Match result and goal-scoring analysis.

definition: A match outcome in which both teams score the same number of goals. A draw is a particular kind of match result, and its truth value is determined by comparing the two goal counts of the match.
name: Draw Result
scope: Match-outcome counting and league-level draw statistics.

definition: A registered football player, identified by a display name and by two external identifier spaces (player_api_id and player_fifa_api_id), and carrying unchanging biographical and physical measurements.
name: Player
scope: Player identity, name lookup, physical profiling and player-level ranking.

definition: The player's body height, recorded in centimetres. Observed values range from about 157 cm to about 208 cm.
name: Player Height
scope: Physical screening of players, e.g. players taller than 180 or shorter than 180.

definition: The player's body weight, stored as a numeric measurement in the Player record. Observed values range from 117 to 243.
name: Player Weight
scope: Physical screening and heaviest/lightest player questions.

definition: The player's date of birth stored as a text timestamp. Because it is a date of birth, a smaller value means an older person and a larger value means a younger person.
name: Player Birthday
scope: Age, birth-year and birth-month filtering of players.

definition: The player's age, obtained by comparing the current date with the player's date of birth. It is not stored as a column and must be derived from the birthday.
name: Player Age
scope: Questions asking for the player's age at present or for the oldest/youngest player.

aliases: prefer to use the right foot when attacking
definition: The foot a player prefers when attacking, recorded on the player's rating snapshot as 'left' or 'right'. It is part of the time-stamped attribute record rather than the biographical player record.
name: Preferred Foot
scope: Foot-preference filtering of players within attribute snapshots.

definition: A dated rating record for one player, holding the FIFA-style skill ratings and the overall rating and potential observed on that date. Each player has many snapshots over time, and each snapshot is a separate record.
name: Player Attribute Snapshot
scope: Any question about skill scores, overall rating, potential or foot preference of a player, especially when a year or date is mentioned.

definition: The single headline strength score of a player on a given snapshot date, ranging from 33 to 94 in this database. Natural-language phrasings such as 'overall strength' or 'overall strength is the greatest' refer to this score.
name: Overall Rating
scope: Player strength ranking, strength thresholds, and snapshot-specific rating lookup.

definition: The highest overall rating a player is expected to reach on a given snapshot date, ranging from 39 to 97 in this database. It is a forward-looking ceiling, distinct from the current overall rating.
name: Player Potential
scope: Questions about the lowest or highest potential players.

definition: The family of fine-grained ability scores recorded on a player attribute snapshot, including crossing, finishing, heading accuracy, short passing, volleys, dribbling, curve, free kick accuracy, long passing, ball control, acceleration, sprint speed, agility, reactions, balance, shot power, jumping, stamina, strength, long shots, aggression, interceptions, positioning, vision, penalties, marking and the tackling and goalkeeper scores.
name: Player Skill Attribute
scope: Any question naming a player ability, whether or not the specific ability is listed separately in this layer.

definition: A player's ability to direct the ball with the head, scored as an integer between 1 and 98 on each attribute snapshot.
name: Heading Accuracy
scope: Questions that rank or filter players by heading ability.

definition: A player's jumping ability, scored as an integer between 14 and 96 on each attribute snapshot. This ability is more sparsely recorded than most others.
name: Jumping
scope: Questions that compare or rank players by jumping ability.

definition: A player's ability to score from distance, scored as an integer between 1 and 96 on each attribute snapshot.
name: Long Shots
scope: Questions that average or rank long-shot ability for a player.

definition: A player's ability to deliver the ball from wide positions, scored as an integer between 1 and 95 on each attribute snapshot.
name: Crossing
scope: Questions that rank or filter players by crossing ability.

definition: A player's ability to convert chances into goals, scored as an integer between 1 and 97 on each attribute snapshot.
name: Finishing
scope: Questions that report or compare a player's finishing ability.

definition: A player's ability to bend the ball, scored as an integer between 2 and 94 on each attribute snapshot. This ability is more sparsely recorded than most others.
name: Curve
scope: Questions that report or compare a player's curve ability.

definition: A player's top running speed, scored as an integer between 12 and 97 on each attribute snapshot.
name: Sprint Speed
scope: Questions that filter or rank players by sprint speed.

definition: A dated tactical profile of a team, holding the numeric style scores (build-up play speed, build-up play dribbling, build-up play passing, chance creation passing, chance creation crossing, chance creation shooting, defensive pressure, defensive aggression, defensive team width) together with a categorical class label for each score.
name: Team Attribute Snapshot
scope: Team playing-style questions, team-level ranking by a tactical score, and interpretation of a team's style class.

aliases: speed in which attacks are put together
definition: A team's tactical tempo score describing how quickly the team moves the ball forward. The natural-language phrase 'the speed in which attacks are put together' refers to this same score.
name: Build-up Play Speed
scope: Ranking and comparing teams by tempo.

definition: A team's tactical score describing how much the team relies on passing to create scoring chances.
name: Chance Creation Passing
scope: Team chance-creation comparison and style classification.

definition: The categorical label paired with a team's numeric style score, naming the band the score falls into (for example the build-up play speed class names Slow, Balanced or Fast, and the chance creation passing class names Safe, Normal or Risky).
name: Team Attribute Class
scope: Questions that ask what a team's style score 'is classified as'.

definition: One of two external identifier spaces for a player. This identifier is carried consistently on both the player record and every player attribute snapshot, so it is the reliable key for linking a player to their attribute history.
name: Player API Identifier
scope: Joining players to player attribute snapshots and listing players by numeric ID.

definition: The second external identifier space for a player, present on both the player record and the attribute snapshots. It is mostly aligned with the other identifier space but is not a complete key for the attribute history.
name: Player FIFA API Identifier
scope: Alternative player identification when the FIFA-style identifier is referenced.

definition: The auto-incrementing integer primary key of the player record. It is a database-local key with no external meaning, and question phrasing such as 'players 6 and 23' refers to this key.
name: Player Surrogate Key
scope: Questions that identify players by a small bare integer without naming them.
